lastText: The Night EndsThe Pass by NightNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15WOLVES SEEN ON THE ROAD FROM VARNAYou go home by night, by a road that is on no map, and sleep each day in a different farm cellar with the lid shut over you. The hunters follow the sea, the railway and the river. They do not follow the wolves. You reach the castle a week before they do. At the pass the old man draws a ring of white bread in the grass around a woman who holds a rifle she does not know how to use, and stays inside it all night. In the morning he goes into the castle with a stake and a hammer. He finds the three in the east wing. You feel them go. The tellings differ, but they agree on one thing: that whatever he did, he did it in a great hurry, as if he were afraid there would not be enough time. People remember that he wept. A girl from the village says that she saw him, on the night of the storm, standing on the cliff with his hands over his face.
